facts.anchor: she immediately notices that her daughter is not in the bed
facts.fact: 凯瑟琳醒来发现女儿不在身旁的床上。

facts.anchor: We have the same phone. I heard it buzz when I got home
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白说两人手机同款，她回家听到响时以为劳拉发的是给自己的消息。

facts.anchor: You’d been planning to leave him? Had you told him? Did he know?
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白追问凯瑟琳是否早就打算离开丈夫、是否已告知他、他是否知情。

facts.anchor: It’s Elise. God, Mom. Why does there always have to be a butwith you?
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白纠正母亲要叫她“伊莉丝”，并质问母亲话里为何总要带“但是”。

facts.anchor: But you’re not grieving at all! You must be thrilled.
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白指责凯瑟琳根本不在哀悼，反而一定很高兴。

facts.anchor: You lied to him too, I’m assuming. For years!
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白认定凯瑟琳对父亲也撒了谎，并且持续多年。

facts.anchor: I know your credit card isn’t here yet.
facts.fact: 伊丽莎白要母亲在她回来前搬走，并说知道母亲的信用卡还没寄到。

facts.anchor: to tell her the whole truth eventually, she thinks, and I will break her
facts.fact: 结尾凯瑟琳想自己终究得把全部真相告诉女儿，而那会毁了她。
